note: Palette of the hack screen (glass AR overlay, DESIGN_BIBLE section 5: thin glowing lines, white-blue base, red for threats, orange for damage). ui/palette.json does not exist yet: when TASK-010 lands, map these names onto it.

usage.line: frames, grid edges, route taken, needle of the hacker sector
usage.ok: a hit: a 120 ms white flash on the node / lane / lock
usage.key: keys 1..4 (digits only), the next key pulses
usage.warn: ICE heat above the alarm level, the time penalty popping out of the timer
usage.threat: a mistake (0.25 s red flash), the ICE window on the frequency ring, the swat telegraph frame
usage.ice: ice nodes (a pale diamond with a cross)

colorBlindSafe: state is never carried by colour alone: blockers are crossed hexagons, ice nodes are diamonds with a cross, keys carry digits, mistakes add a shake and a sound
